title: Interview Scheduling Response
intendedUser: Technology candidate responding to interview invitation
description: Template for responding to an interview scheduling invitation.
template:
Hi [Interviewer Name],

Thank you for the interview invitation for the [Job Title] position at [Company Name]. I appreciate the opportunity and am available for the interview on [Date] at [Time] as proposed.

Please let me know if there's any preparation required or if the format will be technical, behavioral, or both. I'm happy to confirm my availability or propose an alternative time if the proposed slot doesn't work.

Looking forward to our conversation!

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Phone Number]
